The story about Einstein failing math is often attributed to a high school incident where he performed poorly on a geometry test because the teacher gave him a problem that required drawing, and Einstein was not good at freehand drawing. However, this incident has been widely misinterpreted as a failure in mathematics when in reality it was just one specific test where he struggled with drawing rather than an overall failure in math.

It's worth noting that some biographers have suggested that Einstein might have been bored by the traditional teaching methods of his time and could have performed even better if given more challenging problems. However, there is no historical evidence to support any claim that he failed mathematics at school.
